mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed discount rates and accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals economic weakness and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% (3-month moving average), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rise in employment (PAYEMS > 144000) signals an economic contraction with strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 AND PAYEMS > 144000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.5%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to heightened risk of monetary tightening and economic policy uncertainty.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances during high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.5%), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts index (HOUST) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to improved economic sentiment and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1100, it signals a weakening housing market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A falling residential investment (RSAFS < 450000) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals an economic slowdown with insufficient monetary policy support, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS < 450000 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
